turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, nobody called me, and I want to know who decided that and on what basis.
Don't thank me. Answer the question.
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
You can walk me through it once you tell me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in. Then show me the document itself, with dates, not your summary of it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an explanation of why it was entered before anyone called me or spoke to Owen, and the dated document you referred to. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
